subject: math
title: First, Second, Third
about: Order words from first to tenth, plus last and next, read off a line of animals, fruits and vehicles that starts on the left. Ordinal words are not a separate NC Grade 1 standard, but they are calendar and line-order vocabulary his class uses all year, so they sit here with counting (NC.1.NBT.1).
tip: Touch each picture from the left and say the order words together: first, second, third...
